Request.description: D7 draft: send only agent_id. Target must be active and belong to the authenticated account.

Busy.description: number_busy: a call, reply, campaign or number operation is unfinished; agent_unavailable: target inactive. Do not retry until the cause is resolved.

Unavailable.description: number_move_disabled: rollout OFF. number_move_unconfirmed: read the number before retrying; the database may have committed. Never automatically repeat the PATCH.
